verdict.rationale: The SOS offers its own bulk-data product: entity data files for 'requestors of Bulk data' and a downloadable list of active notaries. That is a first-party bulk read/export path across many records. Filing itself is per-entity through the bizfile portal, which sits behind User Access and bot management, and no API was found. missing for 10: bulk or batch filing and write operations, documented bulk-data access mechanics (format, delivery, API), programmatic/agent access to the portal, independent or hands-on corroboration.
